SYMPTOM: Playwright service returned 500 errors after extended use. Logs: 'No space left on device'.
CAUSE: Each Playwright launch creates a temporary Chromium user profile in `/tmp`. These accumulate and fill the container's `/tmp` filesystem.
FIX: Add `tmpfs: - /tmp` to the playwright service in `docker-compose.yml`. Also set `shm_size: 1gb` for Chromium shared memory. The tmpfs mount auto-cleans on container restart.
PREVENT: Any long-running Playwright Docker service needs tmpfs on /tmp.
